title: Label-Window Gridfinity Starter Organizer Set
summary: A simplified, magnet-free Gridfinity-pitch organizer set whose bins hold a small slide-in paper label visible through a front window, so contents are readable without lifting the bin.
coordinate_system: Each part's origin is the center of its own bottom face. +X runs right, +Y runs back, +Z runs up. The baseplate is the ground reference for the assembled set; bins sit in its top-face pockets.

parts.name: Baseplate, 4x3 grid
parts.base_shape: Rectangle 178 x 134.5 x 9 with a 4-column x 3-row grid of 41.5 x 41.5 pockets on the top face
construction_steps: Sketch on XY at z=0 (origin = center of bottom face): rectangle 178 x 134.5, centered, corner radius 3
Extrude 9 in +Z
On the top face (z=9), sketch 12 rectangles, each 41.5 x 41.5 with corner radius 2, centered at every combination of X = -65.25, -21.75, 21.75, 65.25 and Y = -43.5, 0, 43.5
Pocket cut each of the 12 rectangles 6 deep (from z=9 down to z=3)

parts.name: Bin, 1x1 cell, label window
parts.base_shape: Open-top box 41 x 41 x 36, 1.6 mm wall, with a label window on one wall
construction_steps: Sketch on XY at z=0 (origin = center of bottom face): rectangle 41 x 41, centered, corner radius 2
Extrude 36 in +Z
Shell inward 1.6 (wall thickness), leaving the top face open
On the front outer wall (Y = -20.5 plane), sketch a rectangle 26 x 10 centered at (X=0, Z=27)
Cut the rectangle through the front wall
On the inside of the front wall, sketch two ridges, 1 x 1 cross-section, running the full height (Z=0 to Z=36), centered at X = -14.15 and X = 14.15, protruding inward 1

parts.name: Bin, 2x1 cell, label window
parts.base_shape: Open-top box 84.5 x 41 x 36, 1.6 mm wall, with a label window on one short wall
construction_steps: Sketch on XY at z=0 (origin = center of bottom face): rectangle 84.5 x 41, centered, corner radius 2
Extrude 36 in +Z
Shell inward 1.6 (wall thickness), leaving the top face open
On the short front outer wall (Y = -20.5 plane), sketch a rectangle 26 x 10 centered at (X=0, Z=27)
Cut the rectangle through the front wall
On the inside of the front wall, sketch two ridges, 1 x 1 cross-section, running the full height (Z=0 to Z=36), centered at X = -14.15 and X = 14.15, protruding inward 1

parts.name: Bin, 2x2 cell, label window
parts.base_shape: Open-top box 84.5 x 84.5 x 36, 1.6 mm wall, with a label window on one wall
construction_steps: Sketch on XY at z=0 (origin = center of bottom face): rectangle 84.5 x 84.5, centered, corner radius 2
Extrude 36 in +Z
Shell inward 1.6 (wall thickness), leaving the top face open
On the front outer wall (Y = -42.25 plane), sketch a rectangle 26 x 10 centered at (X=0, Z=27)
Cut the rectangle through the front wall
On the inside of the front wall, sketch two ridges, 1 x 1 cross-section, running the full height (Z=0 to Z=36), centered at X = -14.15 and X = 14.15, protruding inward 1

parts.name: Snap lid for the 2x2 bin
parts.base_shape: Flat cap 84.5 x 84.5 x 3 with an 81.0 x 81.0 x 4 press-fit lip on the underside
construction_steps: Sketch on XY at z=0 (origin = center of the lip's bottom face): rectangle 81.0 x 81.0, centered, corner radius 2
Extrude 4 in +Z (lip)
On top of the lip (z=4), sketch a rectangle 84.5 x 84.5 with corner radius 3, centered at (0,0)
Extrude 3 in +Z (cap)

hardware.item: User-supplied cardstock label card, cut to 28 x 34 mm
hardware.notes: Slides down the guide-rail channel inside each bin's front wall; not printed or included

assembly_steps: No assembly of the baseplate and bins — they drop into the grid pockets by gravity and hand pressure, no hardware
Cut a cardstock label to 28 x 34 mm for each bin and slide it down the inside guide rails until it rests on the bin floor, visible through the front window
Press the lid onto the 2x2 bin's open top until the lip seats
